title: agy-fast-worker report contract
description: Shape-only contract enforced via agy's --json-schema flag. Conformance proves the report parses; it does NOT prove the report is true — the dispatching agent still runs its own verification command and derives the edited-file list from the working tree regardless of these values.

status.description: The backend's own claimed outcome (e.g. done, partial, blocked) — advisory only.

files_touched.description: Backend's self-reported edited files — advisory only; the agent's edited-file list is derived independently from git status.

verification.description: Backend's self-reported verification attempt — advisory only; the agent re-runs verification itself.

blocked_reason.description: Set when status is blocked; null otherwise.
